core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ghafoor is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Very forgiving, most forgiving”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghafoor corresponds to the Arabic form غفور (Arabic root غ ف ر (gh-f-r); intensive غَفور (Ghafūr)). Its core sense is ever-forgiving, most forgiving. Ghafoor is Arabic غفور (Ghafūr), an intensive adjective from the root غ ف ر (gh-f-r) meaning 'very forgiving, most forgiving' — a divine name in Islamic tradition. It is the same word already recorded under the earlier slug gafoor, in a different transliteration.
